toolbox_versions.Name: EEGLAB Toolbox to process EEG data

provenance.contact_selection_order: Dataset artifact removal; independent candidate/session robust masks; rank candidate retained-trial Welch ratios; selected mask is final; apply eligibility

selection_numerical_details.power_integral: trapz over inclusive 4-8 Hz and 1-4 Hz bins
selection_numerical_details.trial_weights: equal retained trials pooled across sessions
selection_numerical_details.robust_pool: all maintenance samples of dataset-unflagged trials in the same candidate/session
selection_numerical_details.sensitivity_a: same selected pair, dataset flags only
selection_numerical_details.sensitivity_b: same selected pair and final bipolar mask, deeper-contact signal only
selection_numerical_details.sensitivity_c: primary paired endpoint restricted to native-2000-Hz patients
